biotools.summary: Parapipe is a Nextflow and Singularity-containerized bioinformatics pipeline for high-throughput analysis of Cryptosporidium next-generation sequencing data. It provides a modular and scalable framework for public health laboratories to perform genomic surveillance and epidemiological analysis.
